verdict_reason: A verbatim copy of the v3 suite that tests nothing specific to v0.4.0.

todos.issue: PimsCommonMapperV4Test is PimsCommonMapperV3Test copied with three lines changed (the class name, the mapper type and the gbnagv3/gbnagv4 import). No test in it checks anything that differs between v0.3.0 and v0.4.0, because PimsCommonMapperV4 is itself a copy of PimsCommonMapperV3 with only its imports renamed. A fix to the shared mapping now has to be made, and tested, in two places.
todos.fix: Must: mapping behaviour that is the same in v0.3.0 and v0.4.0 is tested once, and a per-version test exists only for what differs. One way: once the v4 common mapper reuses the v3 logic (see the PimsCommonMapperV4 source finding), drop this copy, or run one parameterised suite against both mappers.
